title: Completion intensity across the Powder River Basin
question: How hard are the region's horizontal oil wells completed, county by county and year by year, and what do they recover?
summary: 2108 horizontal oil wells in the region carry a filed proppant mass and a sound oil fit, all of them in Wyoming. The median well completed in 2011 took 2.34 million lb; in 2024, 25.17 million lb.

title: Filed elevations that do not sit on the ground
question: How many wells hang from a filed elevation that disagrees with the measured ground beneath them, and what explains the disagreement?
summary: 36467 wells in the region carry a filed elevation and sit on the measured grid. The median well is -9.5 m off the ground; 7566 wells, 20.7% of them, are more than 100 m off, and 5595 of those are filed below the ground rather than above it. The commonest thing the numbers support: shared with at least three neighbours: systematic over the area (6984 wells).
